scope: Booking offer sign-in recovery; product only.
boundary: Actual React components in StrictMode, native navigation adapters and real booking/payment services in disposable local PostgreSQL. Fictional preauthenticated users, actual immutable viewer binding and simulated provider; no hosted group exercise, email, model or PayPal calls.
beforeFix: Expired payment mutations left the action active with no sign-in path. An expired refresh redirected away from the loaded offer and discarded confirmations.
journeys: Expired acceptance, approval check, withdrawal and studio cancellation pause actions while retaining the loaded offer and applicable confirmations.
Separate-tab sign-in leaves the original booking review open.
Successful same-account refresh preserves applicable confirmations.
GET failure retains the last loaded offer and disables payment/booking actions.
A different account is rejected by the actual immutable viewer binding; the loaded review stays paused.
Expired first load redirects to sign-in before any private offer loads.
Two lost acceptance responses retain one retry ID and create exactly one participant order.
Restored studio identity preserves cancellation confirmation; its fictional cancellation is reflected on the participant refresh, removing previous payment and withdrawal actions.
verificationCorrection: Initial sibling keys collided and duplicated a checkout panel. Corrected to distinct checkout/change keys before final UI checks. Local studio adapter now queries participant status only for participants, matching the source route.
limits: Local simulated checks do not establish real-human usability or a new PayPal integration result.
Choices remain in the open document; a full reload or closed tab requires a fresh review.
No new hosted group flow or payment action was exercised.
